step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram illustrates Zulily's suggestive search ingestion and serving pipeline. 1. A mobile user generates clickstream data ingested into an Amazon Kinesis Data Stream. 2. Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics filters search events in real-time and forwards them to a second Kinesis Data Stream. 3. A Transformer AWS Lambda function consumes from the stream, calls an external Search API to retrieve related brands/categories, and stores records in Amazon DocumentDB. 4. A Producer AWS Lambda periodically reads from DocumentDB, validates inventory via an Inventory API, and populates Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. 5. A Search API serves cached search suggestions back to the mobile client.
